title: Kèkè Zoom: a zémidjan rider set in Benin, built with AI. Looking for feedback on the game and the workflow
author: Requirement-Prize
selftext:
Kèkè Zoom is a free endless rider set in Cotonou, Benin. You drive a zémidjan (moto-taxi) at night through districts, weave through traffic to the beat, pick up passengers and dodge the police. It was made entirely using Claude and Claude Code, including idea iteration, prototype, testing etc. I used Gemini for things Claude couldnt do.   
  
 I know I dont have the most amazing graphics like some of you here, but I'd love to know your feedback. What do you like? What do you hate? Would you play this? Appreciate the feedback!

comments.author: mrpoopistan
comments.body: The graphics style is perfectly fine. The problem is that there's no sense of action or peril.

replies.author: Broad_Advisor8254
replies.body: Thanks, that's useful! Was that from the video or from playing? Maybe I should have recorded a better video! My bad.

replies.author: mrpoopistan
replies.body: From the video. And the point is that most people are never going to make the jump to the full game because the video makes the game look slow and unchallenging.

replies.author: Broad_Advisor8254
replies.body: That's fair! Thank you for this! I'll get a better video / trailer then. Appreciate the feedback.
